header: Every string the recorder design set shows, once, keyed by the parents' own keys (`recorder.*`, `retention.*`, `storage.*`, `empty.*`, `chip.*`, `gap.*`, `rbac.*`, `notice.*`) else a stable row id derived from the cite (`d02.8.rNN`); `sources` holds each parent's String cell verbatim and `string` the quoted strings alone; `status` PROPOSED mirrors the parent's `new` / PROPOSED provenance; `frozen` names the §20.3 row a string belongs to. `script` is the §6.1 announcement script (the a11y script E16-Q05 and E16-Q01 reuse), derived from the bound attributes, not observed. Generated from the parents at origin/main; the tool fails on any parent row missing (G16-DECK).

sources.D02: Variables, all from the **amendment** `policy` object: `{dwell}` = `autostart_delay_s` (60 s), `{grace}` = `autostop_grace_s` (30 min), `{limit}` = `max_symbols` (20), `{warn}` / `{autostop}` / `{halt}` = the three thresholds (80 / 90 / 95 %); `{cap}` = `StorageUsage.cap_bytes`. Release points are 5 points below each threshold (24 §13.4.1). Durations render as "60 s", "30 min", "1 h 30 min". The boards show the defaults; code never hard-codes them (decision 1).
H1: "Recorder"

d02.8.r03.string: Nothing is recorded by default. A symbol is recorded only while you have added it here, its chart has been open for {dwell}, it has an open position, or a rule or alert depends on it. Auto-recorded symbols stop {grace} after the last reason ends. Live price and order-book views work without recording; history, sub-minute bars and replay need it.
